# 2022 Elections

There were 2 elections held in Jersey in 2022.

- **[Deputies General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2022#e48)**

  37 seats · 76 candidates · 41.6% average turnout
- **[Connétables General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2022#e49)**

  12 seats · 16 candidates · 38.8% turnout

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

View the [**latest tweets from the candidates**](https://flow.je/news/elections-2022).

View the [**BBC Jersey Elections Coverage**](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-europe-jersey-61880332).

View the [**Channel 103 Elections Coverage**](https://www.channel103.com/news/jersey/2022-election-results-live/).

View the [**ITV Channel Elections Coverage**](https://www.itv.com/news/channel/2022-06-22/jersey-election-2022-follow-our-live-blog).
